policies.value: MVC architecture is mandatory with strict separation of concerns.
Frontend: NextJS (TypeScript), Material UI, HTML, CSS; Backend: TypeORM with PostgreSQL.
Validate, sanitize, and encode all client input.
Token-based authentication (JWT) with expiration is mandatory.
RESTful, resource-oriented APIs with URL format: /api/v1/<resource>.
Access Token (short-lived, memory or secure cookie) and Refresh Token (long-lived, secure HttpOnly cookie) must be used.
PostgreSQL is the default and mandatory database.
camelCase naming is mandatory for all tables and columns.
Follow the recommended Next.js project structure.
